item.title: Kazakhstan's future after the elections: Russia, EU or China
item.description: Kazakhstan, where power is being continuously consolidated in the president's hands, will have to continue its tough balancing act between the EU, Russia and China following the parliamentary elections this Sunday.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Spain battles forest fire a short drive from flash flood
item.description: The blaze, near Valencia, forced more than 1,000 people from their homes. In nearby Catalonia, civil defense teams carried out 200 rescue operations after floods trapped residents in cars and homes.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: Myanmar military airstrike kills 14 at Buddhist monastery: reports
item.description: Around 100 people were attending a meditation retreat in central Myanmar when the building was targeted by military planes, witnesses said.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: Small German airplane crashes in Croatia, killing 2
item.description: The two-seater motor glider went down in the Velebit mountains, near Zadar, killing both passengers.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: 'Masha and the Bear': Ukraine sanctions Russian cartoon
item.description: Ukraine has imposed sanctions on the hit Russian children's cartoon "Masha and the Bear," a step towards banning it. The culture minister called the show propaganda. Russia said the move showed Kyiv's "ugly nature."
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: German army helps Poland protect itself against Russia
item.description: Poland is building a defense system along its northern and eastern borders to protect itself from Russia. Since June, German sappers have been assisting their NATO ally with the construction of the East Shield.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: France issues warning over thousands of substandard condoms
item.description: French anti-fraud and health agencies have issued a recall order for roughly 260,000 condoms. They advised users to consider sexually transmitted infection and pregnancy tests amid risks of bursting or perforations.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: Iran's president: Time to end war in 'position of strength'
item.description: Iranian media cite Masoud Pezeshkian as saying it would be a good time to end the war with the US, "as we are in a position of strength and dignity." He also said Tehran would never "bow to intimidation."
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: 40 years after the Lake Nyos disaster in Cameroon
item.description: On August 21, 1986, a silent cloud of carbon dioxide swept through villages around Lake Nyos in Cameroon, killing nearly 2,000 people in their sleep. Four decades later, survivors are still living with the trauma.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Ukraine's farmers struggle to sell harvest amid war, drought
item.description: Russian attacks on ships and ports in the Black Sea are threatening Ukraine's agricultural sector. Grain exports are severely restricted, and Kyiv is seeking solutions.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Panama Canal to cap ship transits due to El Nino drought
item.description: Panama Canal will cut daily transits of ships from September because of low rainfall and amid an intensifying El Nino event.
